papers.title: XYZFlow:Scaling Multi dimensional Shortcut Flows for Efficient Generative Modeling
papers.summary: Sample: introduces a method that improves efficiency without loss of quality. The approach is validated against strong baselines on standard benchmarks.
papers.abstract: Sample abstract: Shortcut flow models trade sampling steps for a learned correction term. We generalize the formulation to multiple coupled dimensions, show that the resulting objective remains a valid flow-matching loss, and demonstrate that the approach scales to high-resolution generation with a fraction of the sampling cost of the diffusion baseline.

papers.title: In-Loop Model Adaptation with Coupled Latent-Noise Guidance for High-Fidelity Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
papers.summary: Sample: proposes a lightweight technique addressing a key bottleneck. Experiments show consistent gains across several settings.
papers.abstract: Sample abstract: Subject-driven generation typically fine-tunes the backbone per subject, which is slow and prone to drift. We instead adapt the model inside the sampling loop, guided by a coupling between the latent trajectory and the injected noise schedule. This preserves subject fidelity without catastrophic forgetting of the prior.

papers.title: TGRHuman: Text-Guided Realistic 3D Human Generation via Diffusion Renderer
papers.abstract: Sample abstract: We generate realistic 3D human avatars from text by pairing a diffusion prior with a differentiable renderer, supervising geometry and appearance jointly. A pose-aware regularizer suppresses the limb artifacts common to score-distillation pipelines.
